name: Kettlebell Plyometric Push-Up
steps: Set one wide-based kettlebell on a firm floor and take a plank with one hand on its handle and the other on the floor.
Bend both elbows and lower your chest between your hands.
Push away explosively to lift both hands and shift your chest across the bell.
Land with the opposite hand on the handle and soften your elbows before reversing direction.
tips: Check that the bell stays planted when you press into the center of its handle.
Keep your feet wide and stop if you cannot land with control.
